title: Built around how nurseries really work

items.title: One-tap check-in
items.body: Parents check in and out from the gate, within a distance you set. Teachers can mark a child in by hand.

items.title: Announcements and events
items.body: Tell the whole nursery or just one room. Announcements and events land on parents' phones. No WhatsApp group needed.

items.title: Safety and health records
items.body: Teachers log an incident in a minute. Every child's allergies, medical notes and authorised pickups are one tap away.

items.title: Know parents saw it
items.body: Parents confirm they have read incident reports, so you are never left guessing.

items.title: Respects quiet hours
items.body: Parents can set quiet hours, and you set your opening days and hours.

items.title: Everyone picks their language
items.body: Staff and parents each choose Arabic or English and see the whole app in it.
